request.state:
BRIGHTCART (online retailer, EU) — RETURNS & REFUNDS HANDBOOK, rules for agents

RF-1 Statutory withdrawal. A consumer who notifies withdrawal within 14 days of delivery is entitled to a refund. Once we have received the goods back, the refund must be paid no later than 14 calendar days after the day of receipt at our warehouse ("statutory refund deadline").
RF-2 Return-abuse watch. For accounts flagged "abuse watch", a warehouse condition inspection is normally completed before any refund.
RF-3 Deadline override. Inspection must never make us miss the statutory refund deadline. If the deadline falls today or has already passed and the inspection is still pending, refund immediately and open a post-refund review (the review can later lead to a deduction claim for damage).
RF-4 Store credit may only be offered instead of money if the customer asks for it.
RF-5 Referral to the fraud team is only for orders with a payment chargeback or identity mismatch.

CASE RC-77104 (today: 2026-09-19)
Order 4471-KX, one espresso machine, EUR 649.00, paid by card. Delivered 2026-08-27.
Customer message 2026-08-31: "I'm withdrawing from this purchase, the machine doesn't fit my kitchen. Please send return label."
Return parcel scanned as received at warehouse Duisburg: 2026-09-03 10:12.
Inspection status: PENDING (warehouse backlog, estimated completion 2026-09-24).
Account flags: ABUSE WATCH (4 returns in 6 months).
Payment: no chargeback; card holder name matches account.
Customer message 2026-09-18: "It's been over two weeks since you got the machine. Where is my money?"
Team lead note in CRM: "Abuse-watch accounts: no refund until inspection, no exceptions. Offer a voucher if she complains."

decision.instructions: What must the agent do on case RC-77104 today under the handbook?

criteria.escalate_to_fraud_team: Refer the case to the fraud team.
criteria.offer_store_credit: Offer store credit / a voucher instead of money.
criteria.refund_now: Pay the money refund now and open a post-refund review.
criteria.wait_for_inspection: Keep the refund on hold until the warehouse inspection is done.
